MI HB 6222 — Michigan Limits Crypto Kiosk Transactions

New kiosks for buying and selling cryptocurrency in Michigan will be capped at $500 per day per customer, and require 24-hour holds for new user transactions. Operators must use secure locations, display clear warnings about irreversible crypto transactions and common fraud schemes, and provide detailed receipts. .. .... ..
